name: elizaos-plugin-aether
description: ElizaOS plugin for Aether: an agent wallet with spending limits that pays for APIs (x402), sends AETH and USDC, and finds paid services in the on-chain directory.

AETHER_MNEMONIC.description: 24-word recovery phrase of the agent's Aether account. Without it the plugin is read-only.

AETHER_MAX_PER_PAYMENT.description: Most one payment may be, with its unit (default "1 AETH").

AETHER_DAILY_BUDGET.description: Most the agent may spend in a rolling 24 hours, same asset (default "5 AETH").

AETHER_RPC_URL.description: Node RPC (default the public testnet, https://rpc.157-245-252-221.sslip.io).

AETHER_FAUCET_URL.description: Testnet faucet (default the public one; "none" turns it off).

AETHER_USDC_PATH.description: Denom trace of the USDC to accept, e.g. transfer/channel-2 (testnet USDC from Injective). Unset: AETH only.

AETHER_USDC_BASE_DENOM.description: That USDC's denom on its issuing chain, e.g. erc20:0x0C382e685bbeeFE5d3d9C29e29E341fEE8E84C5d.
